title: Clutter catalog row
description: One kind of developer clutter, as data: where it lives, how its state is judged, and how it is removed. Rows are data: a new kind never needs a code change. Seeded from docs/2.0/research/D-clutter.md and Noo-Noo 0.7's leak signatures. test/noonoo/validate_clutter.py checks every row.

title.description: a short name in plain words, used after 'The' in the growth line

class.description: decision 1: cache, build and leak go to the Trash, tool runs its own command, data and report are never acted on

paths.description: leaf globs with ~, ${cache:<tool>}, ${claude}, ${codex} and ${support}. For a family row, the folders whose children are grouped

names.description: folder names found inside the checkouts, pruned at the first match

beside.description: one of these files must sit next to a named folder

never.description: paths no row may touch, nor any folder that holds them

skipWhenTracked.description: kept when git tracks the folder

walk.description: false for a mount that must never be walked

minAge.description: seconds the newest file must be old

session.description: agent-scratch: deadAfter, entryIdle, transcriptWindow in seconds, scratchDir

cleanup.description: a tool row's own command as argv

dryRun.description: the command's dry-run argv, or null when it has none

ownerSetting.description: for data and report rows: who keeps it and where the setting lives

every.description: the shortest time in seconds between two scans of the row, at least 600
